name: Ndhavuko Previllage
text:
I have used Axe Connect for a variety of services, including logo design, laptop and computer repairs, IT support and troubleshooting, software installation, and virus removal and performance optimisation.

My experience has consistently been positive. Their service is timely, professional, and affordable, and they communicate clearly throughout the process. The logo design work met my expectations, and the technical support provided for my computer-related issues was efficient and effective.

What stands out most is their reliability. Because of the quality of service I received, I have continued to return to Axe Connect for all my IT-related needs. I would confidently recommend Axe Connect to individuals, startups, and businesses looking for dependable technical support, computer repairs, web services, or design solutions.

name: Natalie F
text: I had a great experience with AXE Connect. I took my laptop to them for repairs, and they did an excellent job. My laptop was fixed properly and is working perfectly again. The service was professional, efficient and reliable. I’m really happy with the results and would definitely recommend AXE Connect!

name: Jessica Lekgoathi
text: My laptop suddenly stopped charging and would switch off after a few minutes of use, which was very frustrating they managed to identify the issue quickly and repaired it professionally. The service was excellent, communication was clear, and the turnaround time was impressive. Since the repair, my laptop has been working perfectly without any problems.

name: Blessing Makhavhu
text: Great service. I’ve used his services 3 times and he’s been very great. First my PC was very slow and i couldn’t install apps and run updates and he diagnosed the issue and got everything working smoothly. The second time I forgot my PC password and he quickly reset it and set a new one. What I appreciate is that he’s very reliable and fast I’ll definitely use his services again. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!

name: Hillary Kuhlula
text: Excellent service from Axe Connect! Very professional, helpful and reliable. I’m really happy with the service I received and would definitely recommend them.

name: Lisakhanya Mahlangu
text:
I have known him personally before he launched his company, as we worked together. Even back then, he was always the person people trusted when they had issues with laptops, emails, website updates, or general IT support. He would even assist with personal laptops, not only work devices, and he always handled everything with patience and professionalism.

He is reliable, knowledgeable, and always willing to help. I have seen his skills first-hand, and I fully recommend his services to anyone who needs laptop repairs, email support, website updates, or IT assistance
